title: NOA Decision Artifact
description: Approver-device-signed (D7, §12) decision bound to the Hold Envelope hash, carrying the reason (F13 reasonEncryption, HPKE-encrypted to the tenant audit key, D23). Domain NOA-Decision-v0.1-sig. Signer TYPE+ROLE = APPROVER + approve-high (HIGH) or approve-critical (CRITICAL/IRREVERSIBLE), F15 — the tier is resolved from the held action's riskClass, not from this artifact.

encryptedReason.description: The noa.encrypted-reason/0.1 HPKE-AEAD blob (D23, F13) embedded in the Decision Artifact; NOT separately signed — the Decision Artifact's own signature covers this WHOLE object. See noa-encrypted-reason-0.1.schema.json.

suite.description: RFC 9180 ciphersuite ids (§4): KEM DHKEM(X25519,HKDF-SHA256)=0x0020=32, KDF HKDF-SHA256=0x0001=1, AEAD ChaCha20Poly1305=0x0003=3 (locked, and the only value this schema admits). AES-256-GCM=0x0002=2 was previously offered here as a second permitted option; no sealer has ever emitted it and the opener refuses it (signer-core/src/encrypted-display.ts:212), so both the enum and this sentence were corrected in place — fail-closed, no spec bump, since no such document has ever existed.
